cards.board-mat: Flat 2D naturalist field-guide illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, clean shapes, gentle cel shading, warm parchment cream, moss green, ochre and slate-blue palette, thin warm-brown outlines, no 3D, no photo realism, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. A top-down view of an old wooden field-guide desk mat divided into three soft horizontal bands: a green forest band at the top, a golden grassland band in the middle and a blue-green wetland band at the bottom, each band empty and calm with faint leaf, grass and ripple patterns.
